parameters.name: BillType
parameters.description:
The billing method for the service. Valid values:

- **PayByTraffic**: pay-by-data-transfer
- **PayByBandwidth**: pay-by-peak-bandwidth

parameters.name: WebsocketBillType
parameters.description:
The billing method for the WebSocket service. Valid values:

- **websockettraffic**: pay-by-data-transfer
- **websocketbps**: pay-by-peak-bandwidth
